evidence.reason: At the pinned tip the exported `git` helper still supplies an `env` object containing only `GIT_*` variables. That replaces the child environment, so there is no `PATH` for executable lookup; Node/libuv then falls back to the default search path and `git` fails with ENOENT on hosts where git is installed outside `/usr/bin:/bin` (e.g. Nix or custom toolchains). The same environment also disables global config, so a globally configured `safe.directory` cannot apply to cross-owner checkouts. This is a concrete portability/correctness defect in the existing git helper, not merely a proposal to enlarge scope, and the current contract does not record it as an accepted limitation.
